descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S24 Real Android and iOS builds on the local stack: native sort picker, keyboard, smart punctuation

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Hospital: search by name, by room, by MRN and by diagnosis each returns the correct matching patients, each field on its own. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 2; TFA-92581 AC 5)
  • U2 Hospital: sort by room, by name and by status each puts the list in the correct order. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 4; TFA-92581 AC 5)
  • U4 Nursing Home: search by name, by unit/room, by MRN and by facility each returns the correct matching residents, each field on its own. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 3; TFA-92581 AC 6)
  • U7 Nursing Home: sort by room (unit/room), by name and by status each puts the residents in the correct order. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 4; TFA-92581 AC 6)

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Local-stack builds only. Android: the debug build bundled for the local stack, installed and connected by scripts/android-lane.ts (adb reverse tcp:4510/4511), on the rc_api36 emulator or a USB phone with the same adb reverse. …

When Search by each field, choose each sort in the native picker, type a search with a search typed and the picker open, type O’Brien with the on-screen keyboard (smart punctuation on)

Then Results and orders are the same as on the web; the keyboard does not hide the results; the native picker lists the three orders and applies them

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Tester compares with S01–S04 and S12 on the same data; the curly-apostrophe result is recorded for Q8. A check on the real store build, if wanted, is for Tim or Daniela with their sign-off (needs-dev-or-prod) and is not part of this matrix

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S24 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both (local debug builds, or store build on dev); Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-03 Search & Sort · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-03/S24

Real Android and iOS builds on the local stack: native sort picker, keyboard, smart punctuation

Tickets: TFA-92581 Search & Sort (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status passed in newspec-c/results.json → passed (passed).

Detail:

Android rig: debug build of main e02167f bundled for the LOCAL stack only (bundle names 127.0.0.1:4510/4511, reached through adb reverse), built outside the checkout, on the rc_api36 emulator (Pixel 7, Android 16); Playwright attached to the app's own WebView; every ai/* action the app sends is answered or failed at the WebView's socket (no model call; aiCallLog had no new row in any run). Judged 22/22 on Android against the desktop web on the same account and S19 data: searches typed with the on-screen keyboard after a real tap (o'brien, jones, 410, 41; d'angelo, 41 in Today's Visits) list exactly what the web lists; with the keyboard up the first result stays visible above it; Android's native picker lists the three orders and each order equals the web's (both contexts); a search typed and the picker opened over it gives the web's filtered, sorted list and keeps the search. Recorded only: '41' also lists Novak through MRN-4100 on both (Q7); 'José' via CDP finds José Núñez; the curly-apostrophe searches O’Brien / D’Angelo (what iOS smart punctuation types) find nothing on the app or the web (Q8). With the keyboard up only about one result card shows above the bottom navigation bar (record). iOS half not run: the simulator cannot be tapped here without a permission prompt (no idb / Maestro / WebDriverAgent installed; the simulator-control and computer-use tools ask first), and the only booted simulator runs someone else's dev-pointed build (b8fb762), which was left alone. A separate prompt-free smoke on a new simulator (dvc-tc24-s24-ios-*) showed the iOS build on the local stack opening and listing patients.

Evidence: 13 attached.

Dev run: skipped: set-aside — set-aside: iOS/Android (Quinn 2026-10-14) — Real Android and iOS builds (native sort picker, on-screen keyboard, smart punctuation).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
